description: If a banner is present, ensure it is clearly visible, properly positioned, straight and free from folds, crumpling or creases.
conditional_applicability: Applies when an NGO banner is present in the frame; return NOT_APPLICABLE if no banner is present.

description: Volunteers should wear white-on-white or a white top with jeans. Ensure clothing is neat, clean and presentable.
conditional_applicability: Applies to all identifiable NGO volunteers performing seva.

description: Ensure the beneficiary’s face and expressions are clearly visible, wherever appropriate. Avoid obstructed faces and awkward cropping.
conditional_applicability: Applies when human beneficiaries are present; return NOT_APPLICABLE for pure animal care or non-beneficiary scenes.

description: Capture genuine expressions and interactions. Beneficiaries and volunteers should not look straight into the camera unless a specific photograph requires it.
conditional_applicability: Direct camera gaze fails or triggers HUMAN_REVIEW unless external metadata specifies that a camera-facing group/banner shot was requested.

description: Prioritise candid moments that capture compassion, kindness, shots that show genuine interaction with beneficiaries rather than staged or overly posed photographs.
conditional_applicability: Applies to all photographs; stiff, staged handovers or artificial poses fail.

description: Clearly showcase the activity being performed, whether food distribution, education support, healthcare assistance, animal care or another seva initiative.
conditional_applicability: Applies to all photographs; the specific seva action must be visually identifiable.

description: Choose an appropriate angle that captures the activity, beneficiary and volunteer interaction clearly. Avoid awkward perspectives, tilted frames and angles that obstruct the subject.
Avoid photographs in which the volunteer’s back is prominently visible. Prefer front or side angles that highlight the volunteer’s involvement in the activity.
conditional_applicability: Applies whenever volunteers are present in the frame.

description: Ensure subjects are well-lit and clearly visible. Avoid dark, overexposed, harshly backlit or shadow-heavy photographs.
Ensure photographs are sharp and in focus. Avoid blurry, grainy or shaky images.
Avoid distracting backgrounds, clutter, scattered materials and unrelated objects that take attention away from the seva.

rule_name: Final QC 1 — Seva Activity Clearly Visible
description: 1. Is the seva activity clearly visible?
conditional_applicability: Final gate check confirming the seva initiative is unmistakable.

rule_name: Final QC 2 — Volunteer and Beneficiary Captured Appropriately
description: 2. Are the volunteer and beneficiary captured appropriately?
conditional_applicability: Final gate check confirming proper dress code, front/side volunteer angle, and unobstructed beneficiary visibility.

rule_name: Final QC 3 — Natural, Well-Framed and Properly Lit
description: 3. Is the photograph natural, well-framed and properly lit?
conditional_applicability: Final holistic check on candidness, framing, lighting, and sharpness.

rule_name: Final QC 4 — Maintains Dignity of Everyone Involved
description: 4. Does it maintain the dignity of everyone involved?
conditional_applicability: Zero-tolerance ethical hard gate: rejects any exploitative, pitiable, or undignified depiction.

rule_name: Final QC 5 — Reflects the Spirit of Humanity and Compassion
description: 5. Does it reflect the spirit of humanity and compassion?
conditional_applicability: Evaluates warmth, genuine human/animal connection, and emotional resonance of the seva.
